The tail current source **M5** is the most likely corrupted element. It is the only mirror device whose current doesn't match its W/L ratio against the reference M6. M5 has W/L ≈ 0.86 versus M6's 0.21 (ratio 4.12), so it should carry about 41 µA. Instead it carries 25.3 µA and sits in triode (Vds = 0.21 V < Vdsat = 0.546 V). The M8 output mirror (ratio 11) lands near its expected current, so the M5 mismatch stands out. The diff pair (M1/M2) is starved, which pulls the common-mode and gain down.
